konu: Classroom Life & Learning: Learning Activities, Personal Learning Styles, Technology (AI & Diyalekt) and Future Plans (Will vs. Be Going To)
ciktilar: ENG.10.2.V1. Students can select and use vocabulary for classroom learning activities, personal learning styles, and learning with technology.
ENG.10.2.G1. Students can make predictions, describe plans, and express the difference between immediate decisions ('will') and planned future actions ('be going to').
Students can give study advice using 'should' and express classroom technology obligations using 'must / have to'.
hatirla: Learning activities & styles: brainstorming, role-play, summarise, analyse, note-taking, mind mapping, visualise, self-assessment.
Technology in class: artificial intelligence (AI), Diyalekt platform, homepage, upload/delete a file, log in/log out, switch on/off.

Öğrencinin kendi öğrenme gelişimini değerlendirmesi (öz değerlendirme)

sorular.soru: Theme 2: Classroom Life & Learning ifadelerini Doğru/Yanlış olarak belirleyiniz.

ifadeler.metin: We use 'will' for spontaneous decisions made at the moment of speaking.
We use 'be going to' for prior plans and evidence-based predictions.
Diyalekt is a traditional paper dictionary printed in the 19th century.
Visual learners should use mind maps, charts, and colourful notes.

sorular.soru: Dijital bir sınıf projesini (E-Portfolio) hazırlayıp teslim etme adımlarını sıraya diziniz.
ogeler: First, do brainstorming in groups and create a mind map to organise your ideas
Second, switch on the classroom PC and log in to the Diyalekt platform
Third, prepare your interactive presentation and summarise the key points
Finally, upload your project file to the homepage and log out safely

sorular.soru: Which verb pair consists of OPPOSITE actions when using a computer in the classroom?
İpuçlarından yararlanarak kelimeleri yazınız ve Türkiye'de geliştirilen dijital İngilizce eğitim platformunu bulunuz.

satirlar.ipucu: To remove a digital file from a computer (verb)
A personal learning strategy using branches and keywords (M_ND MAPPING)
The set of keys used to type on a computer (KE_BOARD)
To sign in to a digital platform (L_G IN)
To gain entry to a website or file (ACC_SS)
To press a button on a computer mouse (CL_CK)
Taking written notes during a lesson (NO_E-TAKING)
